scope_boundaries: Finite nine-geometry synthetic comparison, not a continuous or global design optimum
Every numerical and Reynolds flag retained; no endorsement of the two out-of-scope 12-fin geometries
Required isothermal-base temperature is not a local hot spot or validated high-temperature prediction
Fixed pressure leaves unblocked absolute flows unchanged; sealed fluid conducts without an advected inlet state
Fin-only mass excludes base, duct, fan and other aircraft/cooling-system mass
Hydraulic dissipation is not electrical fan power; viscous heating omitted and separately quantified
Sensitivity scenarios are not confidence bounds; no experimental comparison or aircraft validation is established
packaging_condition: Exclude working __pycache__, bytecode and logs from the portable publication manifest; preserve immutable scientific model, plan, numerical evidence and review bytes.
